'''Tainya''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Duro/Legends|Duro]] adjudicator of the [[Department of Adjudication]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] at the time of the [[Galactic War]]. During the [[Seizure of CZ-198]], he was stationed in the [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka]] facility on the [[CZ-198|moon's]] surface as a [[Quartermaster/Legends|supply officer]] specializing in captured goods.
